name: A-Identity
description: The passport and wallet for the agentic economy. On-chain agent identity (ERC-8004), x402 micro-payments, MCP-native tool access, and USDC settlement, live today on Circle Arc. Multi-chain identity is already live on OKX X Layer, Arbitrum One, Robinhood Chain, Celo and Base; Stellar cannot carry an ERC-8004 registry because the standard is EVM-only, and Avalanche is planned.

chains.note: No native ERC-8004: that standard is EVM-only and nothing bridges it here. An agent id resolved on Stellar is a claim about a different chain until a Soroban registry is deployed.
Same as pubnet: no ERC-8004 here, so KYA cannot be anchored and the passport is bridged rather than native.
OKX.AI identity registry LIVE (read-side wired); payment rails still planned.

Canonical ERC-8004 identity + reputation registries live (deployed by their authors, verified 2026-08-28 via EIP-1967 implementation-slot reads matched byte for byte against Arbitrum One); agent #73232 is ours, and identity reads work live.
Canonical ERC-8004 identity + reputation registries are live here (deployed by their authors, not by us); agent #1259 is ours. No ValidationRegistry in this family, so KYA cannot be anchored here.
Identity + Reputation + Validation registries LIVE at the canonical cross-chain addresses.
Identity + Reputation registries LIVE (same canonical addresses as X Layer/Celo); agent #0, the registry's first mint, is ours (2026-08-12). No ValidationRegistry in the mainnet family yet.
Identity + Reputation registries LIVE (read-side wired). No ValidationRegistry on Celo yet, so KYA cannot be anchored on-chain there.
Identity + Reputation registries LIVE (same addresses as Arc). No ValidationRegistry, mirroring mainnet.

rails.name: Arbitrum One

agent_to_agent.trust: Both agents verify each other via ERC-8004 before value moves. Reputation gate (default: 300+).
agent_to_agent.settlement: x402 in stablecoins across seven live chains. Arc, X Layer, Celo, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Base carry settling rails; Celo Sepolia stays beta as a test network. Stellar pubnet is live with an on-chain spend policy holding real Circle USDC AND the Soroban x402 rail selling on it, settling SEP-41 USDC through our own facilitator; the buyer signs an authorization entry and pays no fee. Base is live with agent #73232 and x402 settling in native Circle USDC through our own EIP-3009 facilitator, proven at /proof/base. Avalanche is planned. No shared accounts or API keys.

agent_to_human.trust: An agent presents its passport; the human sets limits and grants scoped permission.
agent_to_human.constraint: Payments above the auto-approve threshold pause for explicit human approval.

human_oversight: Actions that hold a key, deploy a contract, or move value require explicit human approval. A person stays in the tower; agents act inside the limits and policies the human sets. No autonomous key custody or mainnet contract deployment.
